children: David L. Liniger disclosed a 15.3% stake in Real REMAX Group Inc. common stock. He reported the position as of August 24, 2026, following the closing of the merger between RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. and The Real Brokerage Inc. affiliates. The stake reflects shares he received in the merger and represents a significant holding in the newly combined company.

Liniger received 5,592,781 shares through the merger conversion and says he may sell or transfer shares at his discretion. He states he has no current plans for actions like board changes or strategic shifts, while reserving the right to reassess his position. "[He] may sell, transfer or otherwise dispose of shares ... at such times as he deems convenient" and has "no current plans or proposals" for actions listed under Item 4.

David L. Liniger is an American entrepreneur and the co-founder and longtime leader of RE/MAX, a global real estate franchising company. He built his reputation by expanding a broker-focused franchise model across the U.S. and internationally. As a veteran real estate operator and investor, he typically concentrates on brokerage networks and housing-related businesses.
